data.description: A heavy silver necklace that functions as a universalist wizard's bonded object, letting its bearer spontaneously convert spells of their chosen school.
data.name: Amulet of Magecraft

raw_tokens.value: Allows a universalist wizard to choose one school of spells each day when he prepares spells. He then can use the necklace to spontaneously convert any prepared wizard spell of that school into any other wizard spell of that school he knows; the desired spell must be of the same level or lower than the prepared spell.|PRETYPE:1,EQMOD=Special Quality ~ Bonded Object
